capability.summary: Extract every worksheet from one XLSX workbook as in-memory CSV text
capability.description: Opens one existing workbook with openpyxl in read-only, data-only mode, serializes every worksheet to CSV text, and returns a sheet-name-to-CSV mapping inside a JSON envelope. It does not create `.csv` files or evaluate formulas.
capability.problem_space: Read-only extraction of all XLSX worksheets into CSV strings for downstream processing. It is not a filesystem CSV exporter, worksheet selector, workbook editor, formula calculator, spreadsheet renderer, or converter for legacy `.xls` files.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string at CLI position 1 naming an existing openpyxl-readable XLSX workbook. Output: JSON envelope whose sheets_csv object contains CSV text for every worksheet; no output file is written.
accepted_inputs: an existing `.xlsx` workbook readable by the installed openpyxl version
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "openpyxl", target: string, sheet_names: [string, ...], sheets_csv: {<sheet name>: string, ...}}, exit 0. Non-existing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. Workbook/openpyxl/serialization exception: {status: "error", tool: "openpyxl", message: "<ExceptionType>: <message>"}, exit 1. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: returns CSV strings inside JSON and never creates per-sheet `.csv` files

reads every worksheet and retains all generated CSV strings in the JSON result; workbook size and result size are unbounded, with memory amplification from workbook cells to CSV strings and the outer JSON envelope
has no output truncation and no timeout; large or pathological workbooks can consume substantial memory or run without a time limit
always processes every worksheet and offers no sheet, range, delimiter, quoting, encoding, or output-path controls
loads with data_only=true, so formulas yield cached workbook values rather than formulas and are not recalculated; absent cached values become empty CSV fields
cell types and formatting are flattened through Python/csv string conversion; styles, merged-cell semantics, charts, macros, and workbook structure are not preserved

output_contract.description: JSON envelope listing worksheet names and mapping each sheet name to its in-memory CSV text; no CSV file artifact is written.

intent_tags: extract all XLSX sheets as CSV text
read workbook rows into per-sheet CSV strings
negative_intents: evaluate formulas or preserve spreadsheet formatting
